description: Add or extend an attribute on an existing node type; use to add a field or merge new enum values into an existing one. If the attribute name doesn't exist, it is created. If it exists and is a select/multiselect, new values are merged in (existing values kept). Date values on nodes are written via naumu_update_node as either an ISO date string "YYYY-MM-DD" (single day) or an object { start, end? } with ISO date strings (inclusive range). A "person" attribute holds one person this space knows: a member, a former member or an external person (or several when `multiple` is true); write it on a node by name or email and the server stores the user id. Give every type, attribute and select value you add or rewrite a `description` in the shape its parameter states; stored descriptions you send back unchanged are kept as they are.

description.description: Required on a new attribute. One clause, at most 15 words, in the space's language: what the value tells you and when it is set.

multiple.description: person only - allow several people. Omit to leave the stored flag unchanged.

node_type.description: Existing node type to add the attribute to.

requiredOnWrite.description: True when every write that creates or updates a node of this type must also set this attribute (e.g. "Next contact" on a Company). Omit to leave the stored flag unchanged.

type.description: Attribute type (required). select/multiselect define a closed set of categories - provide their values. string/number/boolean/date/person hold per-node data - pass values: []. A specific calendar date is per-node data, so use type "date" and write the date on the node, rather than adding the date as a select value. "person" references one person this space knows (an owner, assignee, account manager).

description.description: Required on a new select value. One phrase, at most 10 words, in the space's language: the condition that picks it over the other values.

name: naumu_add_attribute
title: Add Attribute to Node Type
